items.coder_A: Elemene is a plant-derived compound; whether it is a licensed medicine (pharmacological) or a herbal product (excluded) is not settled by the record.
items.proposed: has_eligible_candidate = true (elemene candidate), pending licensing evidence
items.reason: Under D30-R5 a botanical-derived product is a candidate only if licensed as a medicine (any national authorisation). The record describes a pharmaceutical 'Elemene injectable emulsion' given IV at defined doses and cites prior RCTs of it 'against malignant tumors'; elemene injection is understood to hold a Chinese (NMPA) marketing authorisation as an antitumour drug, but the record itself does not state this.
